{{short description|French science fiction writer (born 1941)}}
{{BLP sources|date=January 2011}}
'''Philippe Goy'''<ref>[http://www.worldcat.org/wcpa/oclc/16637978?page=frame&url=http%3A%2F%2Fariane2.bibl.ulaval.ca%26checksum%3De6f4b54e805527acb75db71252228c1c&title=Bibliothèque+de+l%27Université+Laval&linktype=opac&detail=LVB%3ABibliothèque+de+l%27Université+Laval%3AARL+Library La Bibliothèque de l'Université Laval ]</ref>  (born 1941) is a French [[science fiction]] writer.  He is a photographer under his real name, but he writes under the pseudo-[[pen name]] '''Philip Goy'''. An alumnus of l'[[École normale supérieure]], he is now a [[physics]] researcher at the [[CNRS]].

== Fiction ==
* ''Le père éternel'' 	 Paris : Denoël  (1974) OCLC 1860252 <ref>[https://www.worldcat.org/oclc/001860252  WorldCat]</ref>
* ''Faire le mur'', (with Stéphane Dumont) Denoël (1980) {{ISBN|2-207-30307-1}} <ref>[https://www.worldcat.org/oclc/016637978 WorldCat]</ref>
* ''Le livre/machine'' (Special mention at the [[festival de Metz]] in 1976) <ref>[https://www.worldcat.org/oclc/003538394 WorldCat ]</ref>
* ''Vers la révolution'' <ref>[https://www.worldcat.org/oclc/4665667  WorldCat ]</ref>
* ''Retour à la Terre, définitif'' (prize for best new writer at the Limoges convention in 1977)
